name: web_fetch
description: Fetch one web page and return structured content. HTML pages are rendered as Markdown by default.

backend.description: Fetch backend id; use web_fetch_backends to discover available ids

exclude_selector.description: Remove matching simple selectors before rendering; comma-separated

focus.description: Terms describing the needed information; low-relevance blocks are pruned

format.description: Output format: markdown, text, clean_html (pruned markup) or html (raw body)

link_mode.description: Render links inline, as numbered citations, or as plain text

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of inline content; full text is saved to a spill file

min_words.description: Drop content blocks with fewer words than this value

refresh.description: Bypass a cached response and update the cache with a fresh fetch

render.description: Require a backend that renders JavaScript; unsupported by the built-in HTTP backend

selector.description: Limit content to simple CSS selectors such as main, #article or .content; comma-separated

wait_for_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait for rendered content; only used by rendering backends
